Beyond Support and Confidence, Lift is another key metric for analyzing patterns.

Lift(A⟹B)= Support(B) / Confidence(A⟹B)
​
 
Lift > 1: Positive correlation (The probability of A and B occurring together is higher than by chance).

Lift = 1: Independent (The occurrence of A does not influence the occurrence of B).

Lift < 1: Negative correlation (The probability of A and B occurring together is lower than by chance).
